text:
Priya Shah: quick follow-up on the console proxy/facade RFC. goal: a tiny front-door for panel queries to centralize RBAC, routing and early degradation without rewriting workers.

Priya Shah: sketch responsibilities: 1) validate token & propagate trace 2) fast cached RBAC decision 3) tenant routing (region/cluster) 4) request shaping (max_rows/max_cells) 5) tiered degradation + early reject 6) short-lived prefix KV cache for hot charts.

Mateo Rivera: agree on centralization. two-mode idea: observe-only (log + metrics) and enforce. helps rollout.

Lin Zhao: caching strategy: decision cache keyed by (tenant_id, principal_hash, action, resource). TTL ~ 1s for interactivity, LRU size per instance ~ 50k. invalidate on permission-change webhook.

Samir Patel: perf note: adding a 12ms hop is fine if facade does only memcache lookups. but if facade calls auth DB we hit p95 > 500ms. so facade must never perform DB expansions inline.

Ravi Krishnan: what about stale allow vs deny? if cache allows but later revoked, window is small (1s) and we have webhook. if cache misses, proxy to worker which runs authoritative check. preserves correctness.

Priya Shah: agree. policy: cache-allow short TTL, cache-deny slightly longer? risk of false deny bad for UX. prefer symmetric TTL and rely on webhook for speedy invalidation.

Mateo Rivera: degrade rules: config-driven, tenant-aware. order example: rows -> projection -> sample -> reject. must be configurable per tier. store config in central config service and snapshot to instances for fast reads.

Lin Zhao: circuit-breaker integration: monitor backend queue latency and worker CPU. threshold example: queue_ms > 150ms for 30s or cpu_util > 85% -> enter degradation. also expose a manual override.

Samir Patel: tests: unit (cache eviction, TTL), integration (auth stub + deny/allow), e2e (full proxy path), and a resilience test that kills auth-service to ensure facade proxies correctly.

Ravi Krishnan: rollout plan: feature flag default off. phases: 1) observe-only in canary cluster 2) enforce in non-prod namespaces 3) staged traffic % in prod tenants 4) full. add fallback in mesh to bypass facade if health fails.

Priya Shah: metrics we need: facade.requests_total, facade.latency.p95, auth_cache.hit/miss, proxy_to_worker.count, degrade.trigger.count, degrade.action.rows/projection/reject, facade.errors. and add trace id passthrough header x-trace-id.

Mateo Rivera: add header x-auth-path: cached|proxied|bypassed to help investigating. also expose x-degrade-reason when a request is altered.

Lin Zhao: sample config snippet for tiers: 
```json
{"tiers": {"enterprise": {"max_rows": 5000, "degrade_order": ["projection","sample"]}, "standard": {"max_rows": 500, "degrade_order": ["sample","reject"]}}}
```

Samir Patel: curl to simulate miss and see headers: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://console-proxy.test/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-trace-id: t123" -d '{"panel_id":42,"rows":600}'
```

Ravi Krishnan: runbook bullets: detect rising facade_p95 -> flip feature-flag to observe-only; if OOMs -> scale up replicas and investigate cache pressure; if auth cache miss storms -> investigate webhook delivery or increase TTL temporarily.

Priya Shah: ownership & action items: Lin -> prototype LRU cache + invalidation hook (1w). Samir -> load harness and perf numbers (2w). Mateo -> dashboard panels + trace propagation (4d). Ravi -> rollout flags + runbook (3d).

ops-bot: canary deploy started for cluster canary-console at 4280012600. status: 1/1 nodes healthy.

Priya Shah: thanks team. let's meet Tue 9am for a short sync. :thumbsup:
